name: B-meson CP asymmetries (historical)
description: Fit the source-era discrepancy in neutral B-meson CP observables with an explicit parameter region or benchmark satisfying the source's stated constraints. This is a historical target, not a claim that the discrepancy persists today.

name: Baryon asymmetry
description: Generate the observed cosmic baryon asymmetry through a quantitatively evaluated mechanism, with its thermal history, CP sources and parameter assumptions stated.

name: Bottom forward–backward asymmetry (historical)
description: Fit the LEP-era bottom-quark forward–backward asymmetry discrepancy while respecting the other constraints examined in the cited analysis. This is a historical, source-specific experimental target, not a claim of a current anomaly.

name: Charged-fermion flavour
description: Reproduce charged-fermion mass hierarchies and mixing patterns to the accuracy explicitly demonstrated by the source. Order-of-magnitude textures and precision fits must be distinguished; suppression of flavour-changing processes alone does not qualify.

name: Cosmic inflation
description: Calculate an inflationary regime with primordial perturbations compatible with the data examined in the source, stating the field trajectory, couplings and relevant reheating assumptions.

name: Dark matter
description: Reproduce the cosmological dark-matter abundance with sufficiently stable states, under the production history and constraints examined in the source. A candidate without an abundance calculation does not qualify.

name: Electroweak hierarchy
description: Demonstrate radiative protection of the weak scale or a calculated separation of scales over a stated energy range. The cutoff, symmetry assumptions and residual tuning must be identified; limited-cutoff protection is not a complete Planck-scale solution.

name: Gauge-coupling unification
description: Calculate a common high-scale value for the three measured SM gauge couplings, with the spectrum, thresholds and approximation stated. This target alone does not establish realistic fermion masses or a complete viable grand-unified theory.

name: Neutrino masses
description: Construct a neutrino mass spectrum compatible with measured oscillation scales. A mass-generating mechanism or a sub-eV scale estimate alone does not qualify; the demonstrated spectrum and any mixing assumptions must be stated.

name: Strong CP
description: Demonstrate suppression of the effective QCD CP angle, for example through the computed axion-potential minimum, under explicit symmetry and breaking assumptions.
